name: Firecrawl
summary: Firecrawl is an API that turns websites into LLM-ready markdown, HTML or structured JSON. It offers search, scrape, crawl, map, parse and an agent endpoint, plus an MCP server. The core is open source under AGPL-3.0 and can be self-hosted, with a hosted cloud version that has extra features.
facts: Search, Scrape, Crawl, Map, Parse, Agent, Interact
$75M Series B led by Smash Capital (Sep 2026)
goodFor: Turning whole sites into markdown for RAG
watchOut: AGPL-3.0 has obligations if you modify and serve it
Cloud version has features the open-source build lacks
Respect site terms and robots rules when crawling
